subject: MSA rewrite + upgrade sequence — redlines and signoff timeline
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@cloudfrontier.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procure@cloudfrontier.com
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + upgrade (MSA rewrite) — kickoff

Tessa —

Thanks for the call this morning. As discussed, CloudFrontier is planning a one-year renewal with an upgrade from Standard to Dedicated capacity (+20% baseline) and we need the MSA updated to reflect a couple of internal procurement requirements before we can trigger the PO:

- Add an exhibit that clarifies data residency and logging retention (US only)
- Narrow the indemnity carveout for third-party claims to match our standard procurement language
- Confirm SLA credit uplift for Dedicated pool (target latency numbers attached)

I've attached a short packet with the OrderForm_v3.xlsx and a summary PDF. Procurement would like legal redlines returned by Wednesday 2026-08-04 so we can route for signoff the following week. Is that feasible on your side?

Also looping in our procurement mailbox for visibility (procure@cloudfrontier.com).

Thanks —
Daniel Park
Director, Cloud Operations
CloudFrontier Inc.
Attachments: CloudFrontier_Renewal_Request.pdf, OrderForm_v3.xlsx
From: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@cloudfrontier.com>
Cc: marucs.lin@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + upgrade (MSA rewrite) — kickoff

Daniel —

Appreciate the packet and the timeline. Looping in Marcus (legal) and Laura (customer success / delivery) so we can move quickly. High-level ack: we can target an initial redline back to you by end-of-day Tuesday (2026-08-03) and a consolidated PDF by Wednesday morning. A few quick clarifying Qs from our side so Marcus can prioritize:

1) For data residency: when you say "US only" — is that all production logs and backups, or just customer-identifiable logs?
2) SLA uplift: are the latency targets in the PDF binding or guidance for engineering?
3) Any new export controls / export ban language the procurement team requires?

Action items I propose:
- Marcus to produce tracked redlines by 2026-08-03 EOD (internal)
- Laura to validate order form capacity numbers and confirm migration window (we tentatively have a 2-week ramp)
- Tessa to coordinate DocuSign routing and billing terms once redlines are agreed

If that timeline looks tight we can ask procurement for Friday (2026-08-06) but we'll try for Wednesday.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Renewal & Expansion
Redwood Inference
From: marucs.lin@redwoodinference.com
To: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@cloudfrontier.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal + upgrade (MSA rewrite) — kickoff

Tessa / Laura / Daniel —

Thanks for the context. I've reviewed the attachments and prepared an initial set of tracked changes (attached: Redlines_from_Marcus_v1.pdf). Key items and rationale below — happy to discuss on a quick call if helpful.

1) Data residency / logs:
- Proposed language restricts backups and full database snapshots to US-hosted infrastructure; we left telemetry/logs at "US by default" but added carveouts for operational debugging (retained 30 days) unless CloudFrontier requires longer retention.
- Request: confirm whether CloudFrontier needs "90-day" retention for security logs; if so we'll update the exhibit text.

2) Indemnity:
- I narrowed the supplier indemnity to direct damages from Redwood's gross negligence or willful misconduct and removed broad third-party IP carveouts that could expose undue risk.
- Procurement's original ask to mirror CloudFrontier's template is broader; suggest we exchange markups on indemnity liability caps and carveouts in a side-by-side for quick resolution.

3) SLA credit uplift:
- Proposed an appendix that ties credit percentages to observed p50/p95 latency for the Dedicated pool. Left placeholder values (10% / 25%) pending engineering confirmation of achievable p95.
- Laura: can you confirm whether the proposed p95 threshold of 350ms is achievable with the requested +20% capacity?

4) Billing / payment terms:
- Made small edits to invoicing cadence to align with CloudFrontier's Net-45 preference. Please confirm procurement will accept Net-45 rather than Net-30.

Next steps:
- Daniel: please confirm retention period for security logs (30 vs 90 days) and whether the standard CloudFrontier indemnity language must be matched verbatim.
- Laura: please validate the capacity and the 2-week ramp window so we can firm the SLA appendix.

I'll standby to take CloudFrontier's markup and produce a consolidated version for countersign.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Commercial
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redlines_from_Marcus_v1.pdf
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@cloudfrontier.com>
To: marucs.lin@redwoodinference.com, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procure@cloudfrontier.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + upgrade (MSA rewrite) — consolidated redlines and next step

Marcus / Tessa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the detailed comments. Procurement reviewed your PDF and provided a single consolidated set of markups (attached) — the biggest outstanding items are:

- Indemnity: procurement insists on keeping limited third-party IP carveouts but will accept a monetary cap tied to the contract value; they propose 1.5x contract value.
- Logs retention: procurement confirms 90-day retention for security logs is non-negotiable for our compliance team.
- Billing: procurement will accept Net-45 if we can include a small early-payment discount (1.0%) for Net-15.

We uploaded the consolidated redline to DocuSign for a parallel signflow (link below). Would you please:
1) Confirm acceptance of the 1.5x cap on indemnity or propose a counter numeric cap
2) Accept the 90-day retention exhibit language or provide alternate phrasing
3) Let us know if the Net-45 + 1% Net-15 discount works for Redwood finance
\DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/embeddedSigning/1234567890abcdef
\We need countersign by COB 2026-08-06 to keep our procurement timeline; if you need an extension to reconcile the indemnity cap please flag immediately and we'll see if procurement can stretch.
\Best,
Daniel Park
Director, Cloud Operations
CloudFrontier Inc.
Attachments: CloudFrontier_Consolidated_Redline.pdf
